headline: Garment unrest causes Tk5,136cr losses at 317 factories: BGMEA
summary: The BGMEA says unrest has caused Tk5,136 crore in losses at 317 garment factories. Bangladesh has also lost export orders worth Tk3,096 crore to competing countries, with the full impact still being assessed.
why: The Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association represents the country's garment exporters, which are a core source of foreign currency. Disruptions to production and orders affect export earnings and global apparel supply chains.
